verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a SaaS equity and fund platform, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions a public API. Every documented workflow (409a requests, option exercises, share classes, board consents) is a UI click-path, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. HRIS integrations and Excel/OCF exports are not a general-purpose API covering what the UI can do.
